calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-21-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: Ellen Chaitin, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288

Petitioner Duretha D. Mazique was present in pro per as guardian ad litem for the minor Jhonae Julieauna Mazique-Terry, placed under oath and examined.
Copy of a filed & notarized signature by Minor's father Marcus Terry, consented for the change of name for the minor was presented in open court.
Proof of Publication is in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name of the minor were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the minor to Jhonae Julieauna Mazique.
Decree Changing Name of the minor was submitted to and signed by the Court.
